question: Which functions and classes defined in this repo's src/ does `rebuild_reference_edges` (src/ibwd/graph/resolution.py) directly call?
result_text:
`rebuild_reference_edges` directly calls nine functions and classes defined in `src/`. I checked each against the function body (`resolution.py:250-338`), and the graph's list matches the source.

| Symbol | Kind | Defined in | Where it's called |
|---|---|---|---|
| `language_of` | function | `src/ibwd/graph/modules.py:22` | filtering source files (line 259) |
| `Sym` | class | `src/ibwd/graph/resolution.py:46` | building the symbol list (line 270) |
| `SymbolIndex` | class | `src/ibwd/graph/resolution.py:80` | `SymbolIndex(syms)` (line 273) |
| `ModuleResolver` | class | `src/ibwd/graph/modules.py:29` | `ModuleResolver(file_ids)` (line 274) |
| `extract_references` | function | `src/ibwd/scanner/references.py:69` | parsing each file (line 285) |
| `_resolve_imports` | function | `src/ibwd/graph/resolution.py:208` | resolving imports and IMPORTS edges (line 291) |
| `SymbolIndex.innermost` | method | `src/ibwd/graph/resolution.py:95` | finding the owning symbol for calls and base classes (lines 300, 314) |
| `resolve_ref` | function | `src/ibwd/graph/resolution.py:113` | resolving calls and base classes (lines 301, 317) |
| `upsert_edge` | function | `src/ibwd/graph/database.py:114` | writing the final edges (line 333) |

The nested helper `add_edge` and the lambda passed to `_resolve_imports` are local to the function, so they aren't in the list. `add_edge` is called from the loop bodies and from that lambda. The other calls are to built-ins, `sqlite3` and `dict`, and to `FileReferences`, which is a type annotation only.
